I've written the next three bug briefs and pushed them to `develop` as fba7c5e9. The report is at `docs/briefs/bugs/architect-task.md.report.md`.

**The red CI:** only one run failed: e064b36e, the #999 fix from this lane, in the arm64 test job. The next run, on 832b07dd, contains that commit and passed. So it looks like the intermittent NK2302 failure the last builders also saw when several runs share the project, and I did no fix-forward.

**Batch** (`docs/briefs/bugs/batch.txt`, in this order). I ran each problem on the current compiler (`target/fast/nikaia`) and each still fails:
1. `b4-1016-list-view-result-slice.md` (#1016, opus, 80 turns, $15). The last builder stopped at `partial`: its patch worked but needed `emit_core_types.nika`, a file its brief didn't allow. I decided that file belongs to the fix. I also decided a nullable `ref Vec[T]?` result follows the same rule (`Option<&[T]>`); it fails in rustc the same way. The patch and test draft were in a temporary folder, so I copied them to `docs/briefs/bugs/b4-1016.*`, and the builder deletes them in its final commit. I explained the decision in a comment on #1016.
2. `b5-1002-hex-digit-built-in.md` (#1002, opus, 70 turns, $12). The grammar built-in `hex_digit`, which Part II 10.8 lists, is rejected as "Undefined rule". The builder also tries the other built-ins in that table.
3. `b6-1010-let-mut-literal-owned-field.md` (#1010, opus, 80 turns, $15). A `let mut` text literal that is reassigned inside an `if` and then pushed into an owned variant field passes the checker and fails in rustc (Mismatched types).

**Issues:** I added `wip` to #1002 and #1010; #1016 keeps the one it had. I removed `wip` from #939: its fix (b6c7c3b7, `Fixes #939`) is pushed, and the issue closes when `main` takes that commit. All three issues in the batch keep `ready`.

**Next candidates:** #1014 (a builder wrote around it), #1038, #1001, #1004.

**Start order:** `nikaia run scripts/agent.nika -- docs/briefs/bugs/b4-1016-list-view-result-slice.md`, a builder on opus, because a builder was blocked on this issue.

**Needs from the main session / owner:** nothing. The shared checkout has another agent's unfinished merge (`check_facts.rs` unmerged) and staged files. I didn't touch them: my commit took only my own files.
